name: sagemaker-geospatial
description: Provides APIs for creating and managing SageMaker geospatial resources.

subcommands.name: delete-earth-observation-job
subcommands.description: Use this operation to delete an Earth Observation job.

subcommands.name: delete-vector-enrichment-job
subcommands.description: Use this operation to delete a Vector Enrichment job.

subcommands.name: export-earth-observation-job
subcommands.description: Use this operation to export results of an Earth Observation job and optionally source images used as input to the EOJ to an Amazon S3 location.

subcommands.name: export-vector-enrichment-job
subcommands.description: Use this operation to copy results of a Vector Enrichment job to an Amazon S3 location.

subcommands.name: get-earth-observation-job
subcommands.description: Get the details for a previously initiated Earth Observation job.

subcommands.name: get-raster-data-collection
subcommands.description: Use this operation to get details of a specific raster data collection.

subcommands.name: get-tile
subcommands.description: Gets a web mercator tile for the given Earth Observation job.

subcommands.name: get-vector-enrichment-job
subcommands.description: Retrieves details of a Vector Enrichment Job for a given job Amazon Resource Name (ARN).

subcommands.name: list-earth-observation-jobs
subcommands.description: Use this operation to get a list of the Earth Observation jobs associated with the calling Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-raster-data-collections
subcommands.description: Use this operation to get raster data collections.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists the tags attached to the resource.

subcommands.name: list-vector-enrichment-jobs
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of vector enrichment jobs.

subcommands.name: search-raster-data-collection
subcommands.description: Allows you run image query on a specific raster data collection to get a list of the satellite imagery matching the selected filters.

subcommands.name: start-earth-observation-job
subcommands.description: Use this operation to create an Earth observation job.

subcommands.name: start-vector-enrichment-job
subcommands.description: Creates a Vector Enrichment job for the supplied job type.

subcommands.name: stop-earth-observation-job
subcommands.description: Use this operation to stop an existing earth observation job.

subcommands.name: stop-vector-enrichment-job
subcommands.description: Stops the Vector Enrichment job for a given job ARN.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: The resource you want to tag.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: The resource you want to untag.
